title: Prospective Multicenter Evaluation of the Clinical Use of the Percutek Thoracic and Abdominal Stent Graft System: Prospective Multicenter Real-World Observational Study
summary:
The study examines the standard procedure for endovascular surgery to treat diseases of the aorta. An advanced, modern, and regulatory-approved stent graft system called “Percutek” has recently become available. It has been improved and further developed in many areas compared to previously available systems. It has only recently become available in Germany and is being used routinely. Consequently, there is not yet extensive experience with the use of the system under clinical conditions in routine practice.
The purpose of this study is to collect data on the use of the stent graft system. To this end, various medical and personal data from patients will be collected and entered into a database. Since the study is observational, the treatment does not deviate from the clinic’s standard procedure. We aim to observe how the improvements in the system affect treatment outcomes in the long term.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Planned or emergency implantation of a Percutek abdominal or thoracic stent graft prosthesis as part of routine care. The indication is determined in accordance with current guidelines, regardless of study participation.

Minimum age of 18 years

The patient’s ability to provide written consent

The patient’s willingness to participate in follow-up examinations
Exclusion criteria:
Contraindications as specified in the Instructions for Use (IFU) or other medical, social, or psychological issues that, in the investigator’s judgment, preclude the patient from participating in the treatment as well as the pre- and post-procedure procedures and assessments.

The patient is unwilling or unable to comply with the study’s follow-up examinations
